PDFHandler.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes the object by storing the supplied file paths and constructing a PdfReader object for each file path, preserving order in a new readers list." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> filepaths </REF>: iterable of file paths "An iterable of file path values used to create PdfReader instances."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the filepaths argument directly to self.filepaths as an instance attribute, preserving the original object reference; note that if filepaths is an iterator or generator, this same object will later be consumed when building self.readers. RESULT self.filepaths]
            [COMMAND Iterate over filepaths in order, calling PyPDF2.PdfReader(fp) for each item fp and collecting the results into a new list; assign that list to self.readers. If filepaths is empty, self.readers becomes an empty list. RESULT self.readers]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
PDFHandler.merge_pdfs:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Merges every page from each PDF reader in self.readers into a single PyPDF2.PdfWriter and writes the combined PDF to output_filepath, returning a confirmation message with that path." merge_pdfs]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self.readers </REF>: sequence of PyPDF2.PdfReader "Source PDF readers whose pages are concatenated in the order they appear."
        <REF> output_filepath </REF>: str "Destination filesystem path where the merged PDF will be written."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: str "Confirmation message stating that the merged PDFs were saved at output_filepath."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create a new PyPDF2.PdfWriter object and assign it to pdf_writer. RESULT pdf_writer]
            [COMMAND Start iterating over each reader in self.readers. RESULT reader]
            [COMMAND For the current reader, start iterating page_num over range(len(reader.pages)); this yields page indices from 0 to len(reader.pages) - 1 inclusive when pages exist, and no iterations when reader.pages is empty. RESULT page_num]
            [COMMAND Within the current reader and page_num iteration, retrieve reader.pages[page_num] and assign it to page. RESULT page]
            [COMMAND Within the same nested iteration, add page to pdf_writer by calling pdf_writer.add_page(page). RESULT pdf_writer]
            [COMMAND After the nested loops finish, open output_filepath in binary write mode as out using a with block. RESULT out]
            [COMMAND While out is open, write the accumulated merged PDF content by calling pdf_writer.write(out). RESULT out]
            [COMMAND After the with block completes, return the string f"Merged PDFs saved at {output_filepath}". RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
PDFHandler.extract_text_from_pdfs:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Extracts text from every page of every reader in self.readers and returns the accumulated list of page texts." extract_text_from_pdfs]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Object exposing a readers collection; each reader has a pages collection and each page provides extract_text()."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> pdf_texts </REF>: list[str] "List of extracted page text strings, one entry per page, in reader-major page order."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize pdf_texts to an empty list. RESULT pdf_texts]
            [COMMAND For each reader in self.readers, iterate over every page index page_num from 0 to len(reader.pages) - 1 inclusive. RESULT page_num]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over reader and the inner loop over page_num, assign page = reader.pages[page_num]. RESULT page]
            [COMMAND Within the same nested loops, call page.extract_text() and append the returned value to pdf_texts. RESULT pdf_texts]
            [COMMAND After all readers and pages are processed, return pdf_texts. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
